cockroachdb.description: CockroachDB Cloud Managed MCP Server — connects the Recall agent directly to the CockroachDB cluster for memory inspection, schema queries, and vector search debugging. Safe by default with read-only mode and full audit logging.

tools.name: crdb_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the CockroachDB cluster

tools.name: crdb_list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the database

tools.name: crdb_describe_table
tools.description: Describe the schema of a specific table

tools.name: crdb_search_memories
tools.description: Search memories using distributed vector indexing with a text query

tools.name: crdb_memory_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about the memory store (counts, categories, graph density)

tools.name: crdb_explain_plan
tools.description: Get the query execution plan for a SQL statement

usage.claude_code: Add this config to .claude/settings.json or use via Claude Desktop
usage.cursor: Add this config to Cursor's MCP settings
usage.vscode: Add this config to VS Code's MCP settings
setup: 1. Create a CockroachDB Cloud cluster at cockroachlabs.cloud
2. Generate an API key from the Cloud Console
4. The agent can now query memories, inspect schema, and debug vector search
5. All queries run in read-only mode with full audit logging
